source_caption:
Bill Hader won his two Emmys for Outstanding Lead Actor in a Comedy Series for Barry during the first two seasons, specifically at the 70th and 71st Primetime Emmy Awards in 2018 and 2019. Though he submitted later episodes from subsequent seasons for consideration, he did not win the lead actor category for those later bids.

Meanwhile, at 2026 Emmys, Kate O’Flynn who just won Outstanding Supporting Actress for playing Patricia in Widow’s Bay casually pitched Bill Hader as Patricia’s brother for Season 2. She said it was simply an idea that came to her… but putting Bill Hader in Widow’s Bay practically feels like an automatic Emmy nomination waiting to happen.

Bill Hader as Patricia’s brother in Widow’s Bay Season 2, would you want to see it happen? 👀

@AppleTV, are you listening??

source_details.title: Jeanne du Barry
source_details.synopsis: Jeanne du Barry is a 2023 French-language historical drama film directed, co-written and produced by Maïwenn and starring herself and Johnny Depp in the leading roles. It also stars Pierre Richard, Benjamin Lavernhe, Noémie Lvovsky, Pascal Greggory, Melvil Poupaud, and India Hair. Its plot centres on the life of Jeanne Bécu, who was born as the illegitimate daughter of an impoverished seamstress in 1743 and went on to rise through the Court of Louis XV to become his last official mistress. Jeanne du Barry is a co-production between France, Belgium and the United Kingdom. It was produced by Why Not Productions and Depp's IN.2 Film, and is distributed by Le Pacte.
